description: Minified JavaScript file implementing Bootstrap Growl-like notifications using jQuery. It defines a notification system with customizable options such as position, animation, icons, and message content.

classes.name: e
classes.description: Constructor function for notification instances, handling creation, positioning, and updates of notifications.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the notification, builds the DOM element, sets icons, styles URL, and positions it.

methods.name: buildNotify
methods.description: Constructs the notification DOM element based on the template and content.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the notification, either as a class or image.

methods.name: styleURL
methods.description: Styles the URL element within the notification.

methods.name: placement
methods.description: Positions the notification on the screen based on settings.

methods.name: reposition
methods.description: Repositions notifications when a new one is added or removed.
